response.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin <> 0 AND sites.riskeval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sites.riskeval;
